title: enform task.released@1 event payload
description: The payload of a task.released@1 event (#256, WF-5, AS-2, I5, I14). The holder, or a flow owner with task.reassign, returned the task of a step to the pool: the event names the instance, the step and the holder it took the task from, and the reason an owner gave.

step.description: The step whose task was released (WF-1).

holder.description: The principal that held the task before the release (AS-2).

reason.description: Why a flow owner released the task; absent when the holder released their own.
